title: Synthetic fixture and discovery for Grok Bot transcript replicas
description: Fixture mirrors base32 blob filenames ending in .transcript.replicas.<conversation-uuid>. Done when: discovery decodes blob names and finds conversations.

comments.author: example-user
comments.text: Synthetic Grok Bot fixture + BDD: sand-client-persistence directory drives discovery of entry-log blobs (hash-named JSON files, roster.json and cloud-agents.json reserved), roster attributions (blob -> agent), and cloud-agent stubs. GrokBotSource::new(root) + discover()/doctor() in src/adapters/grok_bot.rs; fixture steps in tests/steps/grok_steps.rs. Full gate green (bdd 107/107).

right_now_summary: The team is building a fixture and discovery logic for Grok Bot transcript replicas.
